bricks.prompt:
Game asset sprite sheet: exactly six separate rectangular dungeon brick tiles for a brick-breaker roguelike, arranged in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid with wide even spacing, each brick wide 2:1 proportion, front view with a slight top bevel visible, upper-left lighting. Style: elegant detailed pixel-art illustration, chunky crisp pixel clusters, sculpted depth, restrained ivory / beige / charcoal / aged brass palette, 1-pixel dark outline around every brick.
Row 1, left: plain weathered beige limestone wall brick with dark cracked flagstone seams and chipped corners.
Row 1, middle: heavy dark charcoal basalt block bound by two riveted iron straps.
Row 1, right: polished ivory marble tile framed by a thin aged brass inlay border, with a large bold raised dark bronze SWORD laid horizontally across the center, very high contrast.
Row 2, left: same polished ivory marble tile with brass inlay border and a large bold raised dark bronze heater SHIELD in the center.
Row 2, middle: same polished ivory marble tile with brass inlay border and a large bold raised dark bronze HEART in the center.
Row 2, right: dark cracked stone brick with glowing muted vermilion red veins and a raised vermilion SKULL in the center.
The three ivory tiles must clearly contrast with the beige wall brick. Flat plain light grey background, no text, no labels, no shadows on background, no scenery.

icon.prompt: Mobile game app icon, square full-bleed composition (no rounded corners, no border, no text). Style: elegant detailed pixel-art illustration with chunky crisp pixel clusters and sculpted depth, restrained palette of ivory, warm beige limestone, deep charcoal and aged brass, upper-left lighting. Subject: close-up bust of a chibi wandering knight in a closed ivory steel helmet with a narrow dark visor and warm brass filigree, holding up a large glowing pearl orb in one gauntlet in the foreground; behind the knight a beige limestone brick wall with one brick cracking. The pearl orb and the helmet are the two big readable shapes, so the icon still reads at 48 pixels. Background: dark charcoal dungeon stone, flat, no gradient. No red. No letters, no logo, no watermark.
